rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a motor or motor unit, especially an electric one.

example.english: The exhaust fan's motor has broken.
example.jyutping: bou6 cau1 hei3 sin3 ge3 maa5 daat6 waai6 zo2

rows.note: Use 引擎 when “motor” means an engine, especially a vehicle’s internal-combustion engine, rather than an electric motor.

example.english: The motor in my car suddenly stalled.
example.traditional: 我架車個引擎突然熄咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaa3 ce1 go3 jan5 king4 dat6 jin4 sik1 zo2
